args.title: Brightline returns blog + companion — combined summary
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of https://blog.brightline.example/2026/returns and its companion piece (https://insights.brightline.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates reached 24%.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth.
- Resale within 10 days kept most of the margin.
